common.style_usage: Stardew Valley interior pixel art: palette, outline weight (dark coloured, never black), wood grain and shading

sign_wood.description: a long, low wooden shop sign plaque hanging flat on a wall, Stardew Valley pixel art, seen straight on: a carved warm-wood frame with rounded corners and two little brass nails at the top, a plain cream painted panel in the middle left completely BLANK for lettering, a tiny paint palette with dabs of colour carved at each end. Wide and short, filling the width. No text, no letters. Transparent background.

sign_painted.description: a long, low painted wooden sign for an art shop, Stardew Valley pixel art, seen straight on: a rust red border with a thin gold trim, a cream panel in the middle left BLANK for words, a little brush and paint drip painted at the corners, hanging from a short brass chain. Wide and short. No text, no letters. Transparent background.
